name: Google Calendar
_comment: client_id ships empty on purpose: Fused still has to publish a Google Cloud project with a Desktop OAuth client. Google's desktop clients must send their (non-secret, by Google's own docs) client_secret at the token endpoint, so a pack never ships one: FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID and FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET fill both at load, and Advanced on the card takes the id and secret of your own Desktop client (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials, with the Google Calendar API enabled). A card of its own, apart from Gmail and Docs, so connecting the calendar grants nothing else.
privacy: Sign-in and every call go straight from this computer to Google. The token stays on this computer. Fused runs no server in this flow.
